variants.headline: Looking back: home world raises its demands
variants.sub: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had raised what it demands of the colony.

More. It is a short word when somebody else has to supply it. The home world has increased its demands on the colony. Readers deserve a plain question about fairness, without being sold a made-up bill or a promise about how easy it will be to meet.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} in this assessment. An increased demand is not automatically an unjust one, and a responsible judgment should allow a fair case rather than beginning with a verdict of bad faith.

variants.headline: Looking back: a larger claim on the colony
variants.sub: The home world is demanding more from {colony}.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.

More. It is a short word when somebody else has to supply it. The home world has increased its demands on the colony. Readers deserve a plain question about fairness, without being sold a made-up bill or a promise about how easy it will be to meet.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

We support {target} in this assessment. An increased demand is not automatically an unjust one, and a responsible judgment should allow a fair case rather than beginning with a verdict of bad faith.

variants.headline: Looking back: distant authority asks for more
variants.sub: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The home world was demanding more from {colony}.

More. It is a short word when somebody else has to supply it. The home world has increased its demands on the colony. Readers deserve a plain question about fairness, without being sold a made-up bill or a promise about how easy it will be to meet.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We support {target} in this assessment. An increased demand is not automatically an unjust one, and a responsible judgment should allow a fair case rather than beginning with a verdict of bad faith.
